posts.title: Verification and Division of Labor
posts.description: Today, while chatting with someone, we got into a topic: when using AI agents extensively, how do you verify whether the work is feasible, rather than becoming what is called a meat proxy? A meat proxy means a person passing content from an AI agent to another person as is, without any thought. posts.title: The Ultimate Purpose of Reading
posts.description: The purpose of reading is not to compete or compare, not to accumulate knowledge, not to establish authority, and not to memorize right and wrong. The purpose and ultimate goal of reading is to stand at a higher dimension and understand the world: engaging with the world and withdrawing from it, withdrawing from it and engaging with it, with life renewing itself endlessly.
